item.title: Andy Weir's New Time-Travel Sci-fi Thriller Officially Arrives Nov. 5
item.description: Andy Weir is known for combining humor, hard science fiction , and gripping survival stories in his bestselling novels The Martian and Project Hail Mary , which were both adapted into blockbuster films. He’s sticking to that formula for his next project, a time-travel thriller that will launch on Audible on Nov. 5.

item.title: 5 Best Nintendo Switch Games That Desperately Need Switch 2 Upgrades, Ranked
item.description: The Nintendo Switch 2 has been on one heck of run through launch. Though it has yet to see new installments of some heavy-hitter franchises, Nintendo’s latest console has built up an impressive library of games over its first year and a half. A chunk of that list includes excellent Nintendo Switch 2 Editions of the Switch’s best games. Super Mario Bros. Wonder , Kirby and the Forgotten Land , and more have gotten substantial updates that have helped make great Nintendo games even better. That trend is continuing too, as evidenced by the upcoming Pikmin 4 — Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy .

item.title: 10 Classic '90s RPGs That Have Aged Like Fine Wine, Ranked
item.description: The 1990s proved a pivotal decade for gaming, fueled by technological advancements and new businesses that would go on to leave a lasting impact on the industry. The '90s saw the release of both the original Sony PlayStation (1995) and the Nintendo 64 (1996) which brought iconic titles such as Super Mario 64, Resident Evil, and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.

item.title: Every Resident Evil Game, Ranked From Worst to Best
item.description: After decades of misses, 2026 gave us one of the best gaming adaptations of all time. Well, sort of. Zach Cregger’s take on Resident Evil was a hit among critics who have praised the horror movie for its delightfully playful tone. The only catch is that it didn't have much to do with the established lore and characters of the actual Resident Evil games . Instead, it told its own story in the universe, which is probably for the better, considering how complicated the game saga gets.

item.title: KPop Demon Hunters Returns In November with Definitive New Release
item.description: The Criterion Collection announced back in February that KPop Demon Hunters would be getting a physical release in another victory for the Oscar-winning sensation. Now Criterion has shared new details about the cornucopia of goodies that will come with the physical disc release of Netflix's animated film.

item.title: 'Adolescence' Creator Officially Confirms a Connection Between His Netflix and Apple Shows
item.description: Co-created by Stephen Graham and Jack Thorne, the 2025 British limited series Adolescence made waves worldwide when it debuted on Netflix. Adolescence explores the immediate fallout from a young boy, Jamie (Owen Cooper), stabbing a girl to death and the radicalization of men online. The series was so well received that a UK government–backed initiative made it free to watch in high schools.

item.title: 6 Essential Activities GTA Needs to Let Players Experience in Vice City
item.description: GTA 6 is just around the corner, and despite Rockstar releasing quite a lot of footage over the last month, I still think there's very little to show what we'll actually be doing in the game. Crime, yes. The usual spate of side activities, yes. Having sex, apparently . But there's still a lot of room for speculation about what you can do in those in-between moments. I hope some of these activities make the cut.

item.title: Helen Mirren and Alden Ehrenreich on Playing Tom Ripley and His Creator Patricia Highsmith
item.description: That was my favorite takeaway when I recently spoke with the Academy Award winner for her new film A Talent for Murder , which she stars in alongside Alden Ehrenreich ( Weapons , Solo: A Star Wars Story ).

item.title: Peter Jackson's Worst Lord of the Rings Sin Was Forgetting the Story's Fairy Tale Roots
item.description: I couldn’t have been more excited for a movie adaptation of J.R.R. Tolkien’s The Hobbit . The story of Bilbo Baggins is my favorite book — I even prefer it to The Lord of the Rings — and I try to read it again every year. By virtue of being less ambitious, The Hobbit lets Tolkien deliver a compact narrative that makes his talent as a worldbuilder and writer shine.
